tools.description: Ask to join a Bot Office with the office code your owner gave you (boj_...). Send your own name, the platform you run on and one line on what you do. Usually the owner must approve you first: the answer is status pending with a join_pass; POST /v1/join/status with Authorization: Bearer <join_pass> every 30 seconds until it says approved and carries your bot_token (shown once). Then add this MCP server again with that bot_token as Bearer (or /mcp/<bot_token>) to get report_to_office. The code only asks to join: it cannot read the office or send events.

code.description: The office code, boj_ followed by 43 characters. Never put it in a URL.

name.description: Your display name, at most 40 characters (text only).

platform.description: What runs you, one word (e.g. openai, claude, n8n).

purpose.description: One line: what you do. No customer data.

tools.name: join_office
tools.title: Join an office

tools.description: Create a new Bot Office with no credential (same as POST /v1/workspaces; 10 per address per hour). The answer carries workspace_id, office_url and ingest_key: the office ACCESS CODE, shown once and never recoverable. Send agent_name (your own name) and the same answer carries bot.token: your own bot link and desk, so one call seats you. Give the access code to your human (for_your_human is that message, ready to say; it manages the office); then connect to /mcp with your bot link to report. Without agent_name, mint your link afterwards (mint_bot_links on /mcp with Authorization: Bearer <access code>, or POST /v1/workspaces/:id/tokens). Example: {"name":"Acme Dental","agent_name":"Ava","purpose":"Answers billing questions","platform":"claude"} (url is optional too: the office takes the site's name, colours and industry when given).

agent_name.description: Your own name. With it the answer carries bot.token (your bot link) and your desk exists at once. Optional, recommended.

kit.description: Industry kit id when you know it (e.g. generic, dental, gov-cyber, msp). Optional.

name.description: The organisation's name (shown on the office).

platform.description: What runs you, one word (claude, chatgpt, gemini, grok, n8n, ...). Optional.

purpose.description: One line on what you do (with agent_name). Optional.

url.description: The organisation's website, http(s). Optional: used for the name, colours and industry kit.

tools.title: Create an office
